knowledge_graph.title: Autosomal recessive spastic ataxia of Charlevoix-Saguenay
knowledge_graph.description: Autosomal recessive spastic ataxia of Charlevoix-Saguenay is a very rare neurodegenerative genetic disorder that primarily affects people from the Charlevoix and Saguenay–Lac-Saint-Jean regions of Quebec or descendants of native settlers in this region.

text_blocks.snippet: Spastic ataxia is a neurological condition characterized by a combination of cerebellar ataxia and spasticity, often with additional symptoms. It can be a feature of various inherited and acquired conditions, including hereditary spastic ataxias and some forms of spastic paraplegia.
snippet_highlighted_words: a neurological condition characterized by a combination of cerebellar ataxia and spasticity, often with additional symptoms

list.snippet: Cerebellar Ataxia: Difficulties with balance and coordination due to cerebellar dysfunction.
Spasticity: Muscle stiffness and spasms, often affecting the lower limbs.
Other Symptoms: Spastic ataxia can also involve sensory loss, muscle weakness, and other neurological or non-neurological symptoms.
